gloss: end of the Edo period, late Tokugawa era

definitions.gloss: end of the Edo period, late Tokugawa era
definitions.explanation: The final years of the Tokugawa shogunate, roughly from the 1850s to 1868. A turbulent period marked by the arrival of Western powers, internal political upheaval, and the eventual fall of the shogunate leading to the Meiji Restoration.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
The {幕末|ばくまつ} era (roughly 1853–1868) began with the arrival of Commodore Perry's "Black Ships" and ended with the ⟦{明治維新|めいじいしん}→明治維新：16286_meijiishin⟧ (Meiji Restoration). Key figures of this period — such as {坂本龍馬|さかもとりょうま}, {西郷隆盛|さいごうたかもり}, and {新選組|しんせんぐみ} — remain enormously popular in Japanese historical fiction, TV dramas, manga, and films.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {幕末|ばくまつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{志士|しし}: patriots of the late Edo period
- {幕末|ばくまつ}⟦{維新|いしん}→維新：13869_ishin⟧: late Edo period and Restoration
- {幕末|ばくまつ}{期|き}: the Bakumatsu period
